algemene-voorwaarden-michigami.title: General Terms and Conditions Judoclub Michigami

sections.heading: 1. Definitions
sections.content:
1.1 The Club: Judoclub Michigami.

1.2 Member: Any person who has registered with the Club and pays the membership fee.

sections.heading: 2. Purpose and Spirit of Judo
sections.content: Judoclub Michigami promotes the sport of judo with respect, discipline and sportsmanship. We expect all our members to embrace this spirit of judo.

sections.heading: 3. Membership and Registration
sections.content:
3.1 Trial lessons: New members may attend three free trial lessons to get to know judo at Judoclub Michigami Steenbergen.

3.2 Registration: Membership is open to everyone aged 6 and up. After the trial lessons, you must register via the registration form on our website.

3.3 Termination of Membership: You can cancel by e-mail, WhatsApp or verbally during a lesson. Please let us know at least one month before the end of a quarter; your membership then ends at the end of that quarter.

sections.heading: 4. Membership Fees and Costs
sections.content:
4.1 Membership fee: The membership fee is €42 per quarter or €168 per year, payable in advance at the start of each period.

4.2 One-time Costs: A one-time registration fee of €15 applies upon registration. Temporary promotion: registering before 31 December 2026 waives the registration fee (free registration).

4.3 Annual Contribution: In addition, there is an annual contribution of €15 for the club's insurance (formerly the CJJF (Central Judo Jiu-Jitsu Federation) contribution), payable with the first period of the year.

4.4 Changes: The board evaluates the membership costs annually during the board meeting and reserves the right to change the membership fee and other costs. Any changes will be communicated to the members at least one month in advance and in a transparent manner.

sections.heading: 5. Insurance
sections.content:
5.1 All members are insured via the CVZ (Central Insurance Body) during their membership.

5.2 In the event of injury during the membership, the board must be notified. The insurance can then handle the claim.

sections.heading: 6. Liability
sections.content: The club is not liable for any damage that relates to the membership in any way whatsoever, unless the damage falls within the scope of the insurance and the insurer compensates this damage.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to the General Terms and Conditions
sections.content: The board is entitled to amend the General Terms and Conditions. Changes will be announced to the members via the website and/or during training sessions. Changes take effect on the date stated in the announcement.

sections.heading: 8. Final Provisions
sections.content:
8.1 Dutch law applies to the General Terms and Conditions.

8.2 If one or more provisions in the General Terms and Conditions are null and void or are annulled, the remaining provisions shall remain in force. The board will, in consultation with the members, draw up a new provision that preserves the purpose of the original provision as far as possible.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: This code of conduct is a supplement to the general terms and conditions of Judoclub Michigami and covers the rules of judo, ethical standards of conduct, fair play, discipline and respect that we as a club hold in high regard. All members, coaches, volunteers and visitors are expected to abide by this code.

sections.heading: 1. Rules of Judo
sections.content:
Members must know and respect the rules of judo as established by the international judo federations.

The rules are designed to safeguard the safety of all participants and to promote fair competition.

Techniques outside the established rules are not permitted and may lead to disqualification.

sections.heading: 2. Ethical Standards of Conduct
sections.content:
We strive for a culture of integrity, in which honesty and transparency come first.

Discrimination, bullying or other undesirable behaviour is not tolerated.

Conflicts are resolved in a constructive manner, with respect for everyone's opinion.

sections.heading: 3. Fair Play
sections.content:
Fair play means competing with respect for the rules, opponents, referees and spectators.

It is about showing sportsmanship, both in victory and in defeat.

Encouraging a positive attitude and avoiding cheating are essential.

sections.heading: 4. Discipline
sections.content:
Discipline is the foundation for success in judo and includes punctuality, dedication and following instructions.

Members are expected to adhere to the training times and schedules.

Self-control and self-reflection are encouraged, both on the mat and beyond.

sections.heading: 5. Respect
sections.content:
Respect is the core value of our club. This means respect for yourself, your fellow judoka, coaches, and the sport of judo as a whole.

The use of respectful language and gestures is mandatory.

sections.heading: Dear members of Judoclub Michigami
sections.content: We attach great importance to your privacy and would like to inform you about how we handle your personal data and image material. Below you will find an overview of our privacy policy:

sections.heading: 1. Collection of personal data
sections.content:
- We collect personal data via the registration form, such as names, contact details, dates of birth and judo ranks.

- This data is used for administrative purposes, such as member registration, communication and organizing events.

sections.heading: 2. Retention period
sections.content:
- Your personal data is retained for as long as you are a member of Judoclub Michigami.

- Upon deregistration, your data will be deleted within a reasonable period, unless legal obligations prescribe otherwise.

sections.heading: 3. Image material
sections.content:
- During events and training sessions, photos and videos may be taken.

- We use this image material for promotional purposes on our website, social media and other communication channels.

- Your name may be mentioned alongside the image material, unless you indicate otherwise.

sections.heading: 4. Consent
sections.content:
- Upon registration, we ask for your consent for the use of your personal data and image material.

- You can withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us.

sections.heading: 5. Rights of data subjects
sections.content:
- You have the right to inspect, correct and delete your personal data.

- Contact us if you wish to change or delete your data.

We strive to handle your data securely and confidentially.

voorwaarden-clubkampioenschap-2024.title: General Terms and Conditions Club Championship 2024

sections.heading: General Terms and Conditions for the Open Judo Club Championships - Judoclub Michigami Steenbergen
Definitions
sections.content:
"Organization" refers to Judoclub Michigami Steenbergen.

"Participant" refers to every judoka who registers for the tournament.

sections.heading: Tournament
sections.content: The tournament will take place on 27 September 2024. Participants aged 6 to 11 must be present from 18:30, and participants aged 12 and up from 19:30, in the dojo at sports centre De Knotwilg in Steenbergen.

sections.heading: Registration and Participation
sections.content: Registration for the tournament is possible until 28 June 2024 at the latest, or until the organization determines that the maximum number of participants has been reached. Registration for this year is free.

sections.heading: Cancellation
sections.content: Participants can cancel their registration up to one week before the tournament. Since there are no registration fees, no refund applies.

sections.heading: Safety
sections.content: First aid is available during the tournament. Participants are expected to respect the rules of judo and the spirit of judo.

sections.heading: Portrait rights
sections.content: During the tournament, photos and videos may be taken of the participants. These images may be used on social media, WhatsApp and in promotional material of the organization. By participating in the tournament, the participant grants the organization permission to use these images for promotional purposes.

sections.heading: Limited Liability
sections.content: The organization is not liable for any damage, loss or injury unless there is intent or gross negligence on the part of the organization. The liability of the organization is in any case limited to the amount that is paid out in the relevant case under the organization's liability insurance.

sections.heading: Indemnification
sections.content: The participant indemnifies the organization against all claims from third parties arising from participation in the tournament.
